:::{#hero-heading}
I'm a scientist who works with data from instruments and the scientific literature. I write Python for spectral and image processing, statistics and numerical modeling, and I have run an imaging facility and high-pressure experiments.

I'm looking for data science roles in New York City and am open to imaging and geoscience positions.
